{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the general administrative title|[[Prefect (disambiguation)|other definitions of the term]]}}
A '''prefect''' was a governmental title.

The Galactic Empire used [[Imperial Prefect]]s to rule certain planets such as [[Kallistas]], where the prefect [[Dengless Rinn]] was a subordinate to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Linrec]].<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

The head of the [[Imperial Knights Training Facility]] was given the title Prefect.<ref name="Legacy 2013 6">[[Legacy (2013) 6|''Legacy'' (2013) 6]]</ref>
